title: Aizu Normalized Event v1
description: Normalized notification event emitted by the aizu CLI. Receivers MUST ignore unknown optional fields for forward compatibility (see docs/protocol.md). Additional byte-size and nesting limits are enforced in code: the serialized event MUST NOT exceed 65536 bytes (64 KiB).

schema_version.description: Event schema major version. MVP is 1.

id.description: Globally unique event id. UUIDv7 (RFC 9562). Unique within a source.

kind.description: Event kind. MVP supports task completion and agent question.

occurred_at.description: When the event occurred, UTC RFC 3339 with a Z suffix (e.g. 2026-08-12T12:34:56.789Z).

source_id.description: Stable per-spool identifier generated on first run. Any UUID version.

display_name.description: Human-readable source name supplied by the source. Remote values are untrusted candidates; desktop UI and notifications use the receiver's persisted local source label as the authoritative identity.

agent.description: Agent identifier (e.g. generic, or a first-party adapter id).

title.description: Notification title. Max 120 Unicode scalar values.

body.description: Notification body. Max 1000 Unicode scalar values. Must not contain secrets, full prompts, or full responses.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome for task.completed. Adapters use unknown when the agent hook does not expose an outcome.

urgency.description: Optional urgency hint. Defaults to normal when absent.

metadata.description: Optional non-sensitive metadata. Must not contain secrets, full conversation text, or raw environment variables. Unknown properties are permitted for forward compatibility.
